maaroo mahalaa 1 | saran pare guradev tumaaree | too samarath deaal muraaree | tere choj. na jaanai koee; too pooraa purakh bidhaataa he |1| too aad jugaad; kareh pratipaalaa | ghatt ghatt roop anoop deaalaa | jiau tudh bhaavai. tivai chalaaveh; sabh tero keea kamaataa he |2| antar jot bhalee. jagajeevan | sabh ghatt bhogai; har ras peevan | aape levai aape devai; tihu loee jagat pit daataa he |3| jagat upaae khel rachaaeaa | pavanai paanee aganee; jeeo paaeaa | dehee nagaree nau daravaaje; so dasavaa gupat rahaataa he |4| chaar nadee aganee; asaraalaa | koee guramukh boojhai; sabad niraalaa | saakat duramat ddoobeh daajheh; gur raakhe. har liv raataa he |5| ap tej vaae; prithamee aakaasaa | tin meh panch tat; ghar vaasaa | satigur sabad raheh rang raataa; taj maaeaa haumai bhraataa he |6| eihu man bheejai; sabad pateejai | bin naavai; kiaa ttek ttikeejai | antar chor muhai ghar mandar; in saakat. doot, na jaataa he |7| dundar doot bhoot bheehaale | khinchotaan kareh betaale | sabad surat bin. aavai jaavai; pat khoee aavat jaataa he |8| koorr kalar tan bhasamai dteree | bin naavai; kaisee pat teree | baadhe. mukat naahee, jug chaare; jamakankar kaal paraataa he |9| jam dar baadhe; mileh sajaaee | tis aparaadhee; gat. nahee kaaee | karan palaav kare bilalaavai; jiau kunddee meen paraataa he |10| saakat faasee parrai ikelaa | jam vas keea; andh duhelaa | raam naam bin. mukat. na soojhai; aaj kaal pach jaataa he |11| satigur baajh; na belee koee | aithai othai raakhaa; prabh soee | raam naam devai kar kirapaa; iau salalai salal milaataa he |12| bhoole sikh; guroo samajhaae | aujharr jaade; maarag paae | tis gur sev sadaa din raatee; dukh bhanjan sang sakhaataa he |13| gur kee bhagat; kareh kiaa praanee | brahamai indr mahes; na jaanee | satigur alakh. kahahu kiau lakheeai; jis bakhase tiseh pachhaataa he |14| antar prem paraapat darasan | gurabaanee siau preet. su parasan | ahinis niramal jot sabaaee; ghatt deepak guramukh jaataa he |15| bhojan giaan mahaa ras meetthaa | jin chaakhiaa; tin darasan ddeetthaa | darasan dekh mile bairaagee; man manasaa maar samaataa he |16| satigur seveh; se paradhaanaa | tin ghatt ghatt antar; braham pachhaanaa | naanak. har jas, har jan kee sangat deejai; jin satigur har prabh jaataa he |17|5|11|

maaroo mahalaa 5 | soorat dekh; na bhool gavaaraa | mithan mohaaraa; jhootth pasaaraa | jag meh koee rehan. na paae; nihachal ek naaraaeinaa |1| gur poore kee; pau saranaaee | mohu sog sabh bharam mittaaee | eko mantru drirraae aaukhadh; sach naam rid gaaeinaa |2| jis naamai kau; taraseh bahu devaa | sagal bhagat; jaa kee karade sevaa | anaathaa naath deen dukh bhanjan; so gur poore te paaeinaa |3| hor duaaraa; koe. na soojhai | tribhavan dhaavai; taa kichhoo. na boojhai | satigur saahu bhanddaar naam jis; ihu ratan tisai te paaeinaa |4| jaa kee dhoor; kare puneetaa | sur nar dev; na paaveh meetaa | sat purakh satigur paramesar; jis bhettat paar paraaeinaa |5| paarajaat lorreh man piaare | kaamadhen sohee darabaare | tripat santokh sevaa gur poore; naam kamaae rasaaeinaa |6| gur kai sabad; mareh panch dhaatoo | bhai paarabraham; hoveh niramalaa too | paaras jab bhettai gur pooraa; taa paaras paras dikhaaeinaa |7| kee baikuntth; naahee lavai laage | mukat bapurree bhee giaanee tiaage | ekankaar satigur te paaeeai; hau bal bal gur darasaaeinaa |8| gur kee sev; na jaanai koee | gur paarabraham agochar soee | jis no laae le. so sevak; jis vaddabhaag mathaaeinaa |9| gur kee mahimaa; bed. na jaaneh | tuchh maat; sun sun vakhaaneh | paarabraham aparanpar satigur; jis simarat man seetalaaeinaa |10| jaa kee soe sunee; man jeevai | ridai vasai; taa tthandtaa theevai | gurumukhahu alaae. taa sobhaa paae; tis jam kai panth. na paaeinaa |11| santan kee saranaaee parriaa | jeeo praan dhan aagai dhariaa | sevaa surat. na jaanaa kaaee; tum karahu deaa kiramaaeinaa |12| niragun kau; sang lehu ralaae | kar kirapaa; mohi ttahalai laae | pakhaa ferau peesau. sant aagai; charan dhoe sukh paaeinaa |13| bahut duaare bhram bhram aaeaa | tumaree kripaa te; tum saranaaeaa | sadaa sadaa santah sang raakhahu; ehu naam daan devaaeinaa |14| bhe kripaal gusaaee mere | darasan paaeaa satigur poore | sookh sehaj sadaa aanandaa; naanak daas dasaaeinaa |15|2|7|
